title: solidify_mesh: support triangle meshes
description: solidify_mesh currently throws 'requires uniform quad meshes' when given triangulated input. mesh_boolean produces triangulated output, so the natural boolean→solidify workflow is blocked. Add triangle and mixed-face support to solidify_mesh.
definition-of-done: 1. solidify_mesh accepts triangle meshes without error. 2. solidify_mesh accepts mixed quad/tri meshes. 3. Output normals are correct for all face types.
testing-plan: 1. Unit test: solidify_mesh on a triangulated icosphere. 2. Unit test: solidify_mesh after mesh_boolean (tri output). 3. Unit test: solidify_mesh on mixed quad/tri mesh.
